body: Round 1 (PR #228 head f568eab6, same four files, two new commits, no force push): the comment and PR/report rationale are corrected (no 'not derivable' text remains in the PR files); the function now trusts only installed formulae/casks of the listed taps (`brew list --formula|--cask --full-name`) and gives whole-tap trust only to a listed tap with nothing installed. The choice was measured, not asserted: job 110914945531 (50c833b3, item-level only) cleared azure/bicep and hashicorp/tap but still warned for aws/tap (no installed item); job 110919109271 (f568eab6) shows `Trusted formula: azure/bicep/bicep`, `Trusted formula: hashicorp/tap/packer`, `Trusted tap: aws/tap` and no warning. Orchestrator re-derived both log excerpts. pr-feedback on f568eab6: 16 items, 0 warnings; Codex code review (Bot) posted one P2 on the intermediate commit 50c833b3 (aws/tap omitted) — dispositioned fixed:f568eab6, the thread answered and resolved on GitHub; its broader claim is contradicted by measurement 1. bats case updated to the exact call sequence; CI green. Recorded option, not required: an empty listed tap could be untapped instead of whole-tap trusted (Homebrew lists untap first); on an ephemeral runner the difference is negligible, so the measured implementation stands.
